_pages_comment: Per-page envelopes for the four Stella & Chewy frozen-raw pages, hand-captured 2026-08-17 from KPN_Kangaroo.pdf with the current VISION_EVIDENCE_PROMPT. Each page carries its brand mark as page_brand_text; no page of this bundle prints a supplier letterhead (identity absent by honest observation). This is the verification evidence for the pack+case bulk column, which lives ON kpn_trading.pack_price_list.v1 (user ruling 2026-08-17: pack+case is the pack layout plus an optional MBB column, one contract — the separate pack_and_case contract is retired).
_recording_notes: Recorded set: the golden sheet has no reconciled K.P.N. tab yet, so expected.csv is recorded from the verified replay (prices/terms cross-checked against the PDF text layer and the printed pages) rather than projected from the sheet. When the sheet tab lands, add sheet_supplier_label and refresh FROM the sheet.
_pins_comment: Pins chosen for trap diversity: FRB-3 proves the merged size+count cell ('3lb 6包' -> buy 6), FRL-12 proves the leading-number trap ('12lb 2包' -> buy 2, not 12), CAT-FRC-1.25 proves decimal sizes ('1.25lb 4包' -> buy 4), FRBM-4 pins the morsels layout.

not_comparable.product_name: allowed discrepancy (policy 2026-08-13): the sheet holds a human shorthand; the export holds the supplier's printed description
not_comparable.product name [Rosetta]: allowed discrepancy: a hand-authored retail name, not something the pipeline derives
not_comparable.weight: allowed discrepancy: some catalogues genuinely do not print it, and the sheet hand-measures
not_comparable.sellable_uom: allowed discrepancy: not always capturable from the source — BizOps set the sellable unit themselves
